title: Adding LLM Providers and Credentials in Proxy Mode

blocks.text: In AI Guard's Proxy mode, AI Guard acts as a reverse proxy for the LLM provider. As such, you must add the respective credentials to authenticate with your LLM providers.
Before managing LLM provider credentials, access your LLM provider and copy the keys or IAM roles from your LLM provider dashboard.
Register the AI services your apps use: OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, and more.

blocks.item: Go to AI Security Admin Portal > AI Guard > LLMs > Providers.
See image.
Click Add More. The Add LLM Provider window opens.
Enter the following:
Provider Name: Enter a name for your LLM provider.
Providers Type: Select the LLM provider you are using.
Deployment: Select Public or Private.
See image.
Click Submit.

blocks.text: To add the credentials for an LLM provider:

blocks.item: In the AI Security Admin Portal left-side navigation, go to AI Guard > LLMs. Click the Credentials tab.
See image.
On the Credentials page, click Add More. The Add LLM Credentials window appears.
In the Add LLM Credentials window:
Name: Enter the name for the credential.
LLM Provider: From the drop-down menu, select the LLM provider to associate with this credential.
Expires At: (Optional) Select the date when the credential expires.
API Key: Enter the LLM provider credentials that you copied from your LLM provider dashboard.
See image.
Click Submit.

blocks.text: To edit the credentials for an LLM provider:

blocks.item: In the AI Security Admin Portal left-side navigation, go to AI Guard > LLMs. Click the Credentials tab.
See image.
On the Credentials page, in the Action column next to a credential, click the Edit icon. The Add LLM Credentials window appears.
In the Add LLM Credentials window, modify any of the credential information.
See image.
Click Submit.
